Support

If you run into a problem or have a suggestion, please write to us by email.

Contact: ipe.haven@gmail.com

We aim to reply within a few business days.

Helpful details to include

  • Your device model and operating system version
  • The App version
  • Which game you were playing and what happened, with a screenshot if you have one

Frequently asked questions

Is Patchland out yet?

Not yet. Patchland: Claim It All is coming soon to iOS and Android. We will post store links here when they exist.

Do I need an internet connection?

No. The game is played offline against AI lords.

Do you collect personal information?

No. The App and this website collect no personal information and use no analytics. See the Privacy Policy.

Which languages does the app support?

Korean and English.
